source_caption:
Trouble Man is a crime drama centered on a man trying to navigate a dangerous world filled with violence, betrayal, and difficult choices. After becoming involved in circumstances that threaten his safety and future, he is forced to rely on his instincts to survive.
As the situation becomes more complicated, old relationships and new enemies begin creating problems from every direction. Trust becomes difficult to find, and every decision carries consequences.
The story explores themes of loyalty, survival, betrayal, revenge, family, and redemption. The main character must decide who he can trust while confronting the consequences of choices made in the past.
What makes Trouble Man compelling is the constant tension between survival and loyalty. The deeper the character gets involved, the harder it becomes to find a way out without putting himself or the people around him at risk.
More than just a crime story, Trouble Man follows a man caught between his past and the possibility of a different future.
💬 When everyone around you has an agenda, who can you really trust?

source_details.title: Trouble Man
source_details.synopsis: Trouble Man is a 1972 American blaxploitation crime thriller film directed by Ivan Dixon and produced and released by 20th Century-Fox. The film stars Robert Hooks as "Mr. T.", a hard-edged private detective who tends to take justice into his own hands. Its popular soundtrack is written, produced and performed by Marvin Gaye.
